subject.title: fix(cli): align gateway agent timeout default

question: Should omitted `openclaw agent --timeout` calls stop applying the shipped client-side timeout and instead inherit gateway timeout policy?
rationale: The implementation follows the repository’s owner boundary, but it intentionally changes effective behavior for existing users and requires maintainer intent rather than automated inference.

options.title: Accept server-owned omission
options.body: Land this shape so only explicit CLI values override gateway timeout configuration and defaults.

options.title: Preserve the shipped client cap
options.body: Keep the current omitted-timeout behavior and limit this PR to documentation cleanup or a separately approved compatibility design.

recommendation.title: Accept server-owned omission
recommendation.body: Land this shape so only explicit CLI values override gateway timeout configuration and defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced and has most heavily maintained the gateway CLI and current timeout-resolution paths.
